name: butchering
description: Butchering — a timed, posture-based carve on butcherable corpses. Requires a butchering tool; the Butchering skill gates each cut; botches ruin the part and bloody the butcher.

butcher.note: KNOWN GAP: targets a butcherable enemy corpse (corpse.butcher_table). Corpse examine only surfaces loot/attack/pinch (engine hardcode). Discovered instead via the loot router — `loot <corpse>` dispatches BUTCHER when the corpse is empty-but-butcherable. Not surfaceable on examine.
